    UNION
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member

    SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
    UNION
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by
), seed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS document, s.spec AS specification,
           s.release AS release, s.clause AS clause, p.tsg_number AS current_tsg_number
    FROM cr_pack AS p
    JOIN pack_links AS pl ON pl.pack_id = p.id
    JOIN document AS d ON d.id = pl.cr
    JOIN section_links AS sl ON sl.cr = d.id
    JOIN section AS s ON s.id = sl.section_id
    WHERE p.pack_number = 'RP-192916'
      AND d.target_release IN ('Rel-15', 'Rel-16')
      AND s.release = d.target_release
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disposition AS dp
          JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id

       seed.specification AS specification,
       seed.clause AS clause
FROM seed
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM section AS previous_section
    JOIN section_links AS previous_sl ON previous_sl.section_id = previous_section.id
